At SimpsonScarborough, we spend our days building brands that endure, inspire, and elevate the all-important work of colleges and universities in shaping our future. Recognized as a leader in the higher education marketing industry, we are a fully remote team of approximately 70 employees working coast to coast.

We’re looking for a Director, Strategy Planning to lead the development of integrated brand, marketing, content, and media strategies that help colleges and universities navigate complexity, clarify positioning, and move audiences to action. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and strong facilitation skills—connecting research, insight, storytelling, and institutional priorities into strategies that are clear, actionable, and built to drive results.

The Director, Strategy Planning partners closely with clients and cross-functional teams to define problems, uncover opportunities, and shape the strategic direction of high-impact initiatives. This role leads the development of audience-informed strategies, synthesizes complex information into meaningful insight, and ensures recommendations are grounded in both data and real-world application.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead integrated brand, marketing, content, and paid media strategy development for large-scale and high-impact client engagements.
  • Collaborate with internal and client teams at project launch to establish goals, priorities, timelines, milestones, and opportunities for cross-functional integration and long-term growth.
  • Collect, analyze, and synthesize primary and secondary research to uncover actionable insights that inform positioning, messaging, campaign strategy, and audience engagement.
  • Develop and present strategy deliverables that are clear, compelling, and actionable—helping clients align around priorities, opportunities, and paths forward.
  • Partner closely with Creative, Media, Digital, Analytics, Accounts, and PMO teams to ensure strategies are integrated, insight-driven, and effectively executed across channels.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, deliverable integration, and strategic continuity across projects and teams.
  • Build and maintain project documentation, strategic frameworks, and planning materials that keep stakeholders informed and aligned throughout engagements.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6–8 years of experience in marketing, advertising, branding, digital, media, or strategy-related roles.
  • Experience working within a marketing, branding, or creative agency environment.
  • Proven experience developing integrated marketing, content, and brand strategies across digital, social, web, print, and paid channels.
  • Strong understanding of audience research, messaging strategy, marketing planning, and campaign development.
  • Ability to articulate media strategy concepts and connect paid, owned, and earned channels into cohesive strategic approaches.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and persuasively.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into insight and direction.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with research tools, project management platforms, collaboration software, social media management tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Comfortable collaborating with remote, cross-functional teams nationwide.
  • Bachelor’s degree and/or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Salary, Benefits & Perks

  • Salary Range: $105,000.00 - $130,000.00
  • Comprehensive benefits package including nationwide health, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) with employer contribution, employer-paid life insurance and short-term disability
  • Flexible time off (FTO) with additional time-off options, including sick, volunteer & bereavement leave, paid parental leave, a day off on your birthday PLUS two agency-wide closures in the summer and winter
  • Monthly lifestyle stipend to supplement your routine wellness costs like streaming subscriptions, gym, or phone/internet costs.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At SimpsonScarborough, we believe diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are central to our core values and critical to our long-term success. This work requires consistency, intentionality, vulnerability, and accountability. Through our efforts, we strive to make meaningful impact in our work, our workplace, and our industry.

SimpsonScarborough is an equal opportunity employer. We have a strict anti-harassment policy and a zero-tolerance non-discrimination policy. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds regardless of nationality, race, religion, gender identity, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Questions?

For all recruitment-related inquiries, please email .

About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About this role

Senior Directors of Engagement Strategy provide senior‑level leadership across complex engagement strategy programs, shaping how audiences experience brands across channels and moments that matter. This role owns large, multi‑workstream engagement strategies, sets strategic intent, and ensures teams translate direction into cohesive, high‑impact experiences.

Senior Directors are trusted advisors to both clients and internal leaders, guiding critical decisions, resolving ambiguity, and holding the bar on rigor, integration, and performance. Their leadership directly influences engagement effectiveness, client confidence, and the development of strategy talent across the organization.

What you'll do

  • Lead large, complex engagement strategy programs end‑to‑end; set strategic direction, structure workstreams, and ensure high‑quality execution across teams and channels
  • Translate brand strategy into holistic engagement approaches, defining how journeys, ecosystems, channel roles, and activation strategies work together to drive behavior and outcomes
  • Make senior‑level strategic decisions within engagements; prioritize audiences, channels, and experiences based on insight, feasibility, and impact
  • Serve as a senior client partner for engagement strategy; lead high‑stakes discussions, guide decision‑making, and provide clear strategic counsel
  • Partner closely with Brand Strategy, Creative, Media, Analytics, Medical/Scientific, and Account leadership to align strategy, execution, and measurement
  • Use platform, behavioral, and performance insights to refine strategy, support optimization, and strengthen engagement effectiveness over time
  • Anticipate risks, gaps, and misalignment across channels or teams; course‑correct proactively to protect strategic integrity and outcomes
  • Mentor and guide Directors and Associate Directors; review work, elevate strategic rigor, and build confidence in independent leadership

About you

  • 8+ years of experience in engagement, digital, or omnichannel strategy, including leading complex, multi‑workstream engagement initiatives
  • Proven ability to operate as a senior engagement strategy lead—setting direction, guiding decision‑making, and ensuring strategies move successfully from concept through activation
  • Deep experience designing and overseeing journeys, ecosystems, activation strategies, channel roles, and content frameworks
  • Strong strategic synthesis and storytelling skills; able to bring clarity to complexity and align diverse teams around a shared engagement vision
  • Confident client leader and internal partner; able to influence at senior levels and navigate ambiguity with sound judgment
  • Experienced people leader; skilled at coaching Directors and developing future engagement leaders through feedback and example
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally (generally up to 10%)

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.
We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy noticebefore applying to Avalere Health.

Highlights

This is an Associate Vice President-level leadership role for the Strategy discipline. We are looking for someone with at least 10 years of experience leading strategy engagements that include research, analysis, insight development, and strategic direction. Experience within a brand or creative agency environment is strongly preferred, along with demonstrated success developing strategists, evolving methodologies, and guiding complex Partner engagements.

At Parisleaf, we expect someone in this role to:

  • Lead the Strategy discipline, establishing clear standards, methodologies, and best practices that strengthen the quality and consistency of our work.
  • Provide strategic oversight across engagements, ensuring insights are meaningful, recommendations are actionable, and deliverables support each Partner’s goals.
  • Coach, develop, and manage Strategy team members, providing the clarity, feedback, and support they need to grow and deliver excellent work.
  • Serve as a trusted senior advisor and lead facilitator in Partner interactions, navigating complex stakeholders and guiding teams toward alignment and confident decisions.
  • Collaborate with leaders across disciplines to strengthen integrated delivery, proactively identify risks, and ensure strategy effectively informs creative outcomes.
  • Contribute to company growth by supporting business development, identifying opportunities to expand Partner relationships, and advancing company-wide priorities.

About Parisleaf

We are a brand & digital agency specializing in partnering with Nonprofits. Most of our work helps support fundraising efforts by building brands for major fundraising campaigns. As we often say, money is mission fuel in the right hands.

We’re seeking people who share our values of gratitude, responsibility, integrity, candor, and empathy. Curious people who believe good strategy and good design can drive fundraising. We love making things for a living and are in it for the long haul. For us at Parisleaf, that means designing an agency culture built on love and grounded in integrity. Whether the role is in creative, operations, or business development, everyone at Parisleaf is dedicated to helping partners (or Partners, as we refer to them) find and show their purpose.

Our partners want to leave their corner of the world a little better than they found it. They seek creative partners who will advocate for their audience. They want substance and style. They hire us for who we are as much or more than what we do.

About You

You are a strategic leader who thrives at the intersection of people, ideas, and impact. Equal parts coach, practitioner, and partner, you’ll lead our Strategy discipline while continuing to guide some of our most important partner engagements. You’re energized by developing others just as much as you are by solving complex strategic challenges, and you find fulfillment in helping both teammates and partners grow.

You believe great strategy isn’t just about delivering recommendations—it’s about creating clarity, building alignment, and empowering organizations to move confidently toward their vision. You’re comfortable leading executive-level conversations, facilitating workshops with diverse stakeholders, and navigating ambiguity with confidence and empathy. You know how to ask the questions others haven’t considered, uncover meaningful insights, and guide teams toward thoughtful, actionable solutions.

You have a deep appreciation for branding and the many ways it comes to life—from messaging and visual identity to digital experiences, campaigns, and activation. You think holistically, ensuring strategic insights translate into work that is both creatively compelling and organizationally meaningful.

You’re an exceptional relationship builder. You earn trust quickly, cultivate long-term partnerships, and naturally identify opportunities to deepen relationships over time. While traditional sales may not be your passion, you’re energized by stewarding partner relationships, supporting renewals, identifying opportunities for expanded engagement, and helping prospective partners understand the value Parisleaf can bring to their mission.

As a leader, you love helping others succeed. You enjoy coaching strategists, elevating the quality of their thinking, and creating the systems, methodologies, and feedback that strengthen an entire discipline. You’re excited to shape how strategy is practiced at Parisleaf—not just by doing exceptional work yourself, but by building a team capable of delivering it consistently.

You are curious, organized, proactive, and deeply collaborative. You create clarity from complexity, communicate with confidence and humility, and know when to lead, when to listen, and when to challenge assumptions. You think on your feet, read the room well, and bring both rigor and warmth to every interaction. You can confidently defend your recommendations with wisdom, research, and sound judgment, while always setting your ego aside in service of the best outcome for our partners and teammates.

Your experience in the nonprofit and fundraising sector is highly valued. You understand the unique opportunities and challenges mission-driven organizations face and are passionate about helping them build brands and campaigns that inspire generosity and advance their missions.

The Role

The Associate Vice President of Strategy is responsible for leading and developing the Strategy discipline at Parisleaf. This role oversees the quality, consistency, and evolution of our strategic work while managing and mentoring the Strategy team. As a senior strategic leader, the Associate Vice President serves as a trusted advisor to partners, guides complex engagements, and helps shape the agency’s strategic point of view.

The Associate Vice President of Strategy works closely with Creative, Operations, Business Development, and Leadership to ensure strategic excellence across all partner engagements and to continuously strengthen Parisleaf's methodologies, processes, and offerings.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Directly manage, coach, and develop members of the Strategy team.
  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, development planning, and internal meetings, as appropriate. .
  • Establish clear expectations and accountability for strategic excellence.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and career pathing for Strategy team members.
  • Foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration, candor, and continuous learning.
  • Identify growth opportunities and help team members expand their skills and strategic capabilities.
  • Serve as the primary leader and advocate for the Strategy discipline within the agency.

Strategy Methodology & Process

  • Own and evolve Parisleaf's strategic methodologies, frameworks, tools, and best practices.
  • Ensure strategic processes are documented, scalable, and consistently applied across engagements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of strategic work, especially within existing and emerging service lines.
  • Develop training, resources, and guidance that elevate the capabilities of the Strategy team and agency.
  • Partner with the Leadership Team to continuously refine how strategy integrates into the broader partner experience.
  • Help shape and improve agency offerings, services, and strategic deliverables.

Strategic Oversight

  • Maintain quality standards and strategic consistency across the agency’s portfolio of work.
  • Serve as a senior reviewer for key strategic recommendations, presentations, and deliverables.
  • Provide guidance and support to strategists navigating complex partner situations or strategic challenges.
  • Ensure strategic recommendations align with partner goals, fundraising objectives, organizational realities, and agency standards.
  • Identify emerging trends, opportunities, and innovations that strengthen Parisleaf's strategic offerings.
  • Ensure strategic recommendations are grounded in research, informed by stakeholder insights, and aligned with partner goals.
  • Help teams identify opportunities, risks, and areas requiring deeper strategic exploration.
  • Maintain a high standard of thinking, problem-solving, facilitation, and storytelling across all strategic work.
  • Ensure strategic insights are effectively translated into compelling creative and activation outcomes.

Partner Delivery

  • Maintain a pulse on all Partner accounts, providing strategic oversight, identifying risks and opportunities, and supporting teams when senior-level guidance is needed.
  • Lead complex, high-profile engagements from discovery through activation.
  • Serve as a senior advisor to Partner leadership teams, helping navigate organizational challenges, stakeholder dynamics, and critical decisions.
  • Facilitate executive-level workshops, strategic planning sessions, and alignment conversations.
  • Ensure strategic thinking remains consistent, actionable, and effective throughout every phase of an engagement.
  • Partner with Creative and Operations leaders to align strategic direction, execution, and Partner experience.
  • Guide recommendations across positioning, messaging, naming, campaign strategy, donor engagement, and activation.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen relationships, create additional value, and maintain momentum as Partner priorities evolve.

Business Development

  • Partner with Leadership and Business Development teams to pursue new partnership opportunities.
  • Participate in discovery conversations, proposal development, and partner pitches.
  • Contribute strategic thinking and fundraising expertise throughout the sales process.
  • Help shape solutions that align partner needs with Parisleaf's capabilities and approach.
  • Support the development of case studies, presentations, and strategic narratives that demonstrate agency impact.
  • Build relationships that contribute to agency growth and long-term partner success.

Agency Leadership

  • Serve as a leader within the agency, helping shape priorities, initiatives, and culture.
  • Contribute to annual planning, departmental goal setting, and strategic initiatives.
  • Champion strategic thinking across all departments and areas of the business.
  • Partner with Leadership to identify opportunities for agency growth, innovation, and improvement.
  • Contribute to thought leadership through speaking, writing, training, and knowledge sharing.
  • Support cross-functional collaboration and alignment across teams.
  • Act as a steward of Parisleaf's values, standards, and commitment to excellence.

Professional Expectations

  • Demonstrate exceptional communication skills in both written and verbal formats.
  • Exercise sound judgment and decision-making in complex situations.
  • Balance strategic thinking with practical execution and partner needs.
  • Effectively manage time, priorities, budgets, and scope across multiple engagements.
  • Build trust with partners, teammates, and stakeholders through integrity, candor, empathy, and accountability.
  • Remain curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning and improvement.

This is a full-time, remote, salaried position commensurate with experience. We are a fully distributed team. Travel is required.

The Opportunity

At Parisleaf, we write and design all kinds of things, but they always revolve around the brand. And we’re on a mission to help our partners fundraise to help fuel their mission. You will work with our multidisciplinary team on projects ranging from competitive analysis and stakeholder interviews to verbal and visual identity. You’ll devise strategies to ignite, support, and guide the team to build campaign brands, brand guides, print collateral, web, video, and environmental design.

You’ll spend a lot of time on Zoom and onsite with our partners. And while you’ll spend a lot of your time conducting and synthesizing research and developing a strategy for partners, you’ll also be responsible for helping us grow. We are looking for someone who enjoys developing ideas with partners and colleagues and can then hunker down and truly communicate and sell the power of that strategy.

While this is a new role at Parisleaf, we’ve been doing it all along. We’ve developed a proven research process, but we’re looking for someone who lives and breathes strategy and can make their mark on our work and help us continue to refine this department.

Background/Requirements

This is a full-time, remote salaried position commensurate with experience. We are a fully distributed team. Travel is required. We only accept applications from candidates currently residing in the continental United States. We are committed to building a diverse and passionate team. Women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ individuals are encouraged to apply.

Parisleaf provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or veteran status. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Salary: $140,000 – $160,000 / year

The Role

    We’re hiring several freelance strategists—one Senior Strategist and two Strategy Leads—to support B2B marketing work for a fast-moving technology client across multiple lines of business and campaign workstreams.

    The work spans brand-level anthems, podcasts, integrated campaigns, and mid- and lower-funnel social content.     The Strategy Leads will take greater ownership of strategic direction, senior client partnership, and alignment across interconnected workstreams.     • Develop clear strategic narratives for integrated marketing campaigns and social content.
    • Translate business objectives, audience insights, and campaign strategy into actionable direction for creative teams.
    • Partner closely with strategy, design, motion, and production throughout concept development and execution.
    • Help connect individual social executions to a cohesive campaign idea and broader marketing goals.
    • Synthesize complex information into focused briefs, frameworks, presentations, and creative guidance.
    • Present strategic thinking clearly and respond thoughtfully to feedback from clients and internal partners.
    • Navigate multiple lines of business, evolving priorities, and fast-moving work without losing strategic clarity.
    • Ensure alignment between the audience insight, campaign narrative, creative idea, and final execution.
    • Shape brand-level narratives and translate them into clear campaign platforms, creative briefs, and channel-specific strategies.
    • Develop strategic direction across formats including brand anthems, podcasts, social campaigns, and performance-oriented content.

  • Significant strategy experience within an agency, brand, or similarly fast-paced creative environment.
  • A strong background in marketing and campaign strategy, particularly across social and digital channels.
  • Experience developing mid- and lower-funnel content that connects creative storytelling to specific audience actions or business goals.
  • Excellent synthesis and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex inputs into clear, persuasive narratives.
  • Strong creative instincts and experience partnering directly with design, motion, and other creative disciplines.
  • Confidence managing multiple workstreams and collaborating with a range of internal and client stakeholders.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and facilitation skills.
  • The judgment to work independently, identify what matters most, and keep teams moving through ambiguity.
  • Curiosity about emerging technology and AI, along with thoughtful judgment about how they can inform strategy and creative work.
    • For the Strategy Lead level, we’re also looking for demonstrated experience owning strategy across complex engagements, building trust with senior client stakeholders, guiding multidisciplinary teams, and maintaining a cohesive strategic direction across interconnected workstreams.

What We Offer

    The expected contract pay range: $61-$102 per hour. Contract compensation is determined by location, experience, and skillset. The Strategy Director develops and delivers integrated brand, omnichannel, customer experience, and communications strategies across healthcare and life sciences engagements for regional and global clients. The role partners with client stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams across Client Services, Creative, Medical Strategy, Science & Regulatory, and Project Management to translate complex commercial challenges into clear strategic direction and actionable recommendations.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop integrated brand, omnichannel, customer experience, and communications strategies across HCP and consumer audiences, translating market, customer, and commercial insights into actionable strategic plans.

  • Support brand planning sessions, content and activation strategy planning and presentations for senior stakeholders, developing recommendations that inform brand, customer experience, and commercial decisions.

  • Partner with Client Services, Creative, Medical Strategy, Science & Regulatory, and Project Management to connect commercial objectives, scientific context, customer insights, and creative execution across integrated engagements.

  • Apply data, customer insights, behavioural science, emerging trends, and AI-enabled approaches to strategic planning to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and strengthen strategic recommendations.

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in healthcare communications, pharmaceutical and consumer health strategy, life sciences consulting, or integrated agency strategy, with experience supporting complex regional or global client engagements.

  • Demonstrated experience developing integrated brand, omnichannel, commercialisation, customer experience, or communications strategies for pharmaceutical, consumer health, Medical devices, biotechnology, and/or healthcare brands, with examples of strategies carried from planning into execution.

  • Experience facilitating client workshops, strategic planning sessions, and presentations for senior stakeholders, with examples of strategic recommendations informing brand, customer, or commercial plans.

  • Experience partnering across Client Services, Creative, Medical Strategy, Science & Regulatory, and Project Management to develop and deliver integrated strategic recommendations.

  • Experience contributing to healthcare or life sciences new business pitches, proposals, and organic growth initiatives, with examples of developing strategic inputs that supported new or expanded client engagements.

Desired:

  • Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.

  • Experience developing strategy across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, rare disease, specialty care, vaccines, or consumer health.

  • Experience supporting regional or global healthcare brands across EMEA including adapting strategy to different market and customer contexts.

About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About The Role
This role is a high-leverage operator reporting into the Director of Industry Strategy & Transformation, with direct exposure to revenue leadership and account owners. This role exists to define and scale CoLab’s supplier ecosystem strategy, building the repeatable go-to-market motion that links OEMs with their Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers so that every strategic account is connected to the network behind it.
This is a customer-facing, go-to-market, and product-influencing role. The right person is part strategist, part operator, part competitor. Someone who can read a room of executives, build a hyper compelling value case on the fly, see the supply network sitting behind the account in front of them, and close out the next step before the meeting ends.

Job Responsibilities

  • Define and own CoLab’s supplier ecosystem strategy, a scalable and repeatable go-to-market motion for how design collaboration extends from our customers into their Tier 1 and Tier 2 supply base and how that network compounds value for every company connected to it.
  • Shape how the supplier motion is packaged, priced, and resourced, partnering with product, revenue leadership, and finance to define what suppliers get, how they buy, and which teams own each stage from first connection to expansion.
  • Map the supply networks behind strategic accounts, identifying which suppliers carry the most design dependency, where feasibility, RFQ, DFM, tooling, and PPAP handoffs break down, and where the cost of that friction lands on each side.
  • Build the value case in both directions, why an OEM should bring its suppliers into CoLab and why a supplier should want to be there, grounded in quote quality, no-bid visibility, cycle time, rework, and launch risk.
  • Package supplier and network strategy plays that prospecting, BDR, and customer success teams can run without you in the room, from target lists drawn from customer supply networks to outreach angles by tier and expansion sequences for CS.
  • Spot where connected suppliers and adjacent customers become new opportunities, and build the motion that turns a supplier’s first seat in someone else’s workspace into its own enterprise relationship with CoLab.
  • Run executive, management, and user workshops that expose workflow friction on both sides of the OEM and supplier relationship and create the urgency needed to mobilize multi-stakeholder buying groups.
  • Bring the supplier network into deal strategy on CoLab’s most strategic opportunities, partnering with account executives to coach champions, align stakeholders across engineering, quality, supply chain, and procurement, and build the executive narratives that move buying groups forward.
  • Track how the motion performs, from supplier activation to supplier-sourced pipeline, and turn those signals into structured product feedback and a clear view of where to invest next.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • You've worked inside an OEM, and you understand the supplier side of the relationship.
  • You bring direct experience in engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, supplier quality, or product development at an OEM, where you've owned or worked closely with the handoffs to Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers. Time on the supplier side is a strong plus.
  • You know what an OEM feels when a part misses PPAP and what a supplier feels when a late change lands on a quote, and you can speak credibly to both.
  • You are a network thinker. You see an account as one node in a larger system, and you can look at a customer's supply base and quickly see where the leverage is, which relationships will carry adoption, and which ones will stall it.
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to read a room of executives in real time. You know when to push, when to pause, when to ask the harder question, and when to take the win and move on.
  • Competitive by nature. You are wired to play to win, you put in the reps, and you run at high cadence. You take losses personally enough to learn from them and not personally enough to slow down.
  • Sharp sense of time value. You understand which work compounds, which work is throwaway, and which conversations are worth a calendar hold versus a quick Slack. You make calls and you move.
  • Clear, direct communicator. You write concisely, present without filler, and can build a clean, compelling deck under pressure. You know that a strong deck is a forcing function, not a deliverable, and you build them that way.
  • Fluent with AI tools as a force multiplier. You know how to use AI to compress research, sharpen messaging, and build faster. You don't just tolerate the tools, you intentionally reach for them to do more with less.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • You have defined CoLab’s supplier ecosystem strategy, and multiple strategic accounts are actively bringing their suppliers into CoLab as a result.
  • You have shaped how the supplier motion is packaged, priced, and resourced, and it runs as a repeatable motion across the revenue org.
  • Your network plays are in use by prospecting and CS, with supplier-sourced pipeline and expansion you can point to.
  • You are owning strategic supplier mapping workshops with our top enterprise accounts.
  • You have meaningfully influenced the outcome of multiple seven figure deals.
  • You are trusted to drive customer leadership conversations without backup.
